name: poly-commit-reload
description: Publish each melodic track's chord bank from its committed playback identity instead of from the pattern loader. Hook 0x08021528, the per-track call to 0x08023158 inside the playback-start loop over the track table: call the stock letter select first, then read the track's now-final letter at [track+0x2e] and load /project<letter>/track<n>/poly<letter> into bank 0x1000B530 + n*0x880, where n is the track's index in the same table the fan-out uses (0x08038370). This runs after the switch commit (0x08021338) has installed the incoming project's patterns and letters. Melodic tracks are recognised by [track+0x2d] == 1 (the test stock uses at 0x080213D8 and the player at 0x0801F544), so the drum is skipped wherever it sits; banks 0..2 only are written because that is the range the fan-out can resolve. To keep SD traffic off ordinary play presses the publish is gated on 'the letter changed during this pass' or on the switch flag at 0x2000C5D8. FR_NO_FILE zeroes the bank because the sidecar is genuinely absent; FR_NO_PATH and every other FRESULT leave the bank untouched, so a misresolved directory can never silence a track that plays today.

patches.note: playback-start per-track letter select -> publish from the committed letter
